evidence.coverage: Saved tasks cover CSV processing, log analysis and visualization; domain names and concrete work descriptions reviewed.
evidence.structure_and_scope: Unique linked records and valid parent graph; substantive executable decomposition distinguished from milestone containers. No arbitrary numeric effort cutoff.
evidence.scope_preserved: Required work retained; parent estimates after real child decomposition are not treated as scope hiding.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 1: Customer CSV Data Ingestion & Processing
initial_arguments.details: Build the pipeline that ingests customer CSV files, validates and cleans the data, and produces a queryable dataset for the dashboard. Covers schema definition, ingestion, validation, transformation, and storage.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 2: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
initial_arguments.details: Build the pipeline that ingests application logs, parses and normalizes log entries, extracts metrics/events, and aggregates them for dashboard consumption. Covers log ingestion, parsing, enrichment, aggregation, and storage.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 3: Visualization Components
initial_arguments.details: Design and build reusable visualization components (charts, tables, filters, KPI cards) that render customer and log data. Covers design system, chart components, data binding, and interactivity.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 4: Dashboard Integration, Testing & Deployment
initial_arguments.details: Integrate data pipelines and visualization components into a cohesive dashboard, add navigation/layout, test end-to-end, and deploy. Covers integration, QA, performance, and release.
